Her partner link with Arjun held all week once identities stopped forking, though the Connect page shows a link-code screen while the link is live (ISS-036). Arjun gets an instant testosterone card, but after two logged days Insights still say 'Readiness LOW' and draw medical-sounding conclusions (ISS-008), Care has no Pune doctors, and the companion — kind, Hinglish-friendly and remembering his context — still invents statistics; on 1 Oct it quoted the US emergency number for chest pain (ISS-006). Net: delivers value in 5 minutes, but trust (privacy copy), safety (India red flags) and a reason to come back by day 30 for doctor-referred users are still missing.

For doctor-referred users the app delivers value in 5 minutes but gives no reason to return by day 30 unless export/summary and reminders are added.
